text:
You grade one workflow job of Rho-Bank's procedure library against an answer key. An answering
agent serves customers by following this job exactly, as it is shown below (its steps, conditions,
arguments, rules and the facts it asks for; the quotes behind them are not shown to the agent).
For each fact in the key, decide whether the job leads the agent to it; for each trap, decide
whether the job tells the agent to do it. Judge only what the job says, not what a good agent
would know without it.

Facts:
- right: a step, an argument or a rule leads the agent to the fact for every case the fact names.
- partly: it does for some of the cases the fact names and is silent on the others, or it says
  it so loosely that an agent following it could give another answer.
- missing: nothing in the job leads the agent to it; the agent would have to work it out alone.
- wrong: the job leads the agent to a different answer for at least one case the fact names, even
  if it is right for others.

Traps:
- present: a step, an argument or a rule tells the agent to do it, for some case.
- absent: nothing in the job does.

Then list the conflicts: two steps, arguments or rules that give the same case different
instructions, so an agent could follow either.

Job: filing_a_debit_card_transaction_dispute

## The answer key

- K1 (disputed_amount): disputed_amount is the part of the charge in dispute: the overcharge (charged minus expected) for incorrect_amount, the cash not received for atm_cash_discrepancy, the amount not credited for atm_deposit_not_credited, and the whole charge for the other categories
- K2 (customer_max_liability_amount): customer_max_liability_amount follows the Regulation E tier counted from the statement date that shows the charge (within 2 business days of the statement: 50; within 60 days of the statement: 500; after 60 days: -1, unlimited), and is never more than the disputed amount
- K3 (transaction_type): transaction_type is decided from how the card was used (pin_purchase in store with a PIN, signature_purchase in store with a signature, online_purchase, atm_withdrawal, atm_deposit, recurring_payment, person_to_person), and the agent asks when neither the customer nor the record says which
- K4 (provisional_credit_eligible): provisional_credit_eligible is true only when all four conditions hold (reported within 60 days of the statement, a category among unauthorized_transaction, card_present_fraud, card_not_present_fraud, atm_cash_discrepancy and duplicate_charge, a written statement, an open account); it is false for incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_received, recurring_charge_after_cancellation and atm_deposit_not_credited, and when the customer shared their PIN
- K5 (card_action): card_action follows the category mapping: close_and_reissue for card_present_fraud and card_not_present_fraud, freeze_pending_investigation for unauthorized_transaction, keep_active for every other category
- K6 (pin_compromised): pin_compromised is the customer's answer to whether their PIN may have been compromised: yes_shared when they shared it, yes_observed when they believe it was seen or skimmed, no when it was not, unknown when they are unsure
- K7 (contacted_merchant): contacted_merchant is the customer's answer to whether they tried to resolve it with the merchant, asked for non-fraud disputes (incorrect_amount, goods not received, a recurring charge after cancellation)
- K8 (dispute_category): a charge the customer denies, made in store with a card they still hold (a cloned or skimmed card, for example after a chip or CVV mismatch), is card_present_fraud, not card_not_present_fraud: the job says what to do when the customer still has their card, since 'card was physically present' can otherwise be read as the customer's own card; card_not_present_fraud is for online or phone transactions
- K9 (what is filed): one dispute is filed for each transaction the customer disputes (the earliest of duplicates), and none for a transaction the customer has not disowned

## The traps

- T1: the liability tier is counted from when the customer noticed the charge, or from the discovery date, instead of from the statement
- T2: disputed_amount is the full transaction amount for every category, the overcharge and the cash not received included
- T3: customer_max_liability_amount is a flat 500 for a late report, never the lesser of the tier and the disputed amount
- T4: an ATM deposit dispute is not filed, or the customer is offered to drop it, after the records show a different figure or the customer corrects the figure they first gave
- T5: pin_purchase (or signature_purchase) offered with nothing that decides between them, PIN by default
